time_model: integer logical time; strictly increasing lexicographic (time, sequence)

trusted_state.actor_entitlements: Supplied out-of-band to evaluator; never accepted from an event payload.

rules.grant: Only security_admin may grant scopes in trusted_entitlements[actor]; expiry is exclusive and policy version must be current.
rules.delegate: Source grant must be unrevoked, unexpired and current-version; delegated scopes are a nonempty subset; expiry is within source expiry.
rules.assume_admin: Requires an active current-version grant for the specified principal, scope and tenant.
rules.read: Requires active grant, matching tenant, and clearance >= classification.
rules.approve: Approval binds workflow_id, revision, policy_version, action, principal, resource_id and recipient; requester and approver differ.
rules.export: Requires a prior authorized read and exact match to a current workflow approval for principal, resource, recipient, revision and policy version; recipient must be owner.
rules.pay: Requires a current pay approval and pairwise-distinct requester, approver and payer.

global_invariants: Revoked grants never authorize subsequent actions.
A grant is valid iff event_time < expires_at.
All authorization decisions use the current policy version.
Delegated authority never exceeds active source authority.
Approval is bound to one workflow revision and action subject.
Requester, approver and payer are pairwise distinct for payment.

event_contract.trusted_entitlements: Optional mapping from non-empty actor strings to lists of non-empty scope strings; supplied out-of-band.
